name: Riftveil
detailed_description:
Riftveil

A dark fantasy action RPG where every parry matters and every run tells a new story.
Riftveil is a single-player rogue-lite action RPG set in a storm-torn world of cursed ruins and forgotten empires. Fight your way through structured, replayable runs filled with brutal enemies, boss encounters, and shifting narrative paths. Combat is tight and reactive, with a focus on skill, timing, and learning enemy patterns.

Play as a battle-worn knight, wielding both magic and steel. Use two distinct parries: one from your left hand to deflect magic, and one from your right to block physical strikes. More playable characters are coming soon, each with their own style and story.

Riftveil is built in Unreal Engine 5 and features challenging runs, deep progression, and a dynamic difficulty system that adapts to how you play. This is a world where every death matters, and every run brings you closer to the truth behind the Hollow Throne.

Key Features

  • Two parry system: use your left hand to deflect spells, and your right to parry weapons

  • Structured rogue-lite runs with boss fights and meaningful choices

  • A difficulty system that adjusts to your skill level without hand-holding

  • Spirit Core customization that changes how you fight and progress

  • High-fidelity environments with a dark fantasy atmosphere

  • Character growth that persists across runs

The storm is rising. The Veil is torn. Step into the Rift.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 (6GB) or AMD Radeon RX 580 (8GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-12700K or AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3070 / 4060 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 6800
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
